visual.description: Warm off-white/cream used as the primary page background across most sections.
Vibrant amber/golden yellow used for CTA buttons, accent highlights, links, and brand accent elements.
Very dark near-black brown used as the footer and newsletter section background.
Saturated golden orange used as the bold section background color for the benefits/accordion section.
Pure white used for large hero headings and footer heading text on dark backgrounds.
Near-black dark brown used for body text, labels, and pill/tag text on light backgrounds.
Golden yellow accent color also used for nutrient pill borders and highlighted link text in the footer.
Transparent/cream nav background in top-of-page state blending with hero.
Dark near-black used for the hamburger menu icon and logo mark in the navigation.
Nav background remains cream/off-white after scroll, consistent with page background.
Dark text in nav remains unchanged after scroll.
White used for nutrition facts table surface and pill/tag interiors.
Muted warm tan used for table/grid borders in the nutrition facts panel.
